title: Generalized amenability in quantum groups
summary: We study generalized amenability of locally compact quantum groups $\mathbb{G}=(\scr M, Δ, φ, ψ)$. Let $C_r^*(\mathbb{G})$ and $VN(\mathbb{G})$ denote, respectively, the C*-algebra and von Neumann algebra generated by the quantum left regular representation of $\mathbb{G}$. With natural covariance assumptions and a traceability condition on $VN(\mathbb{G})$, we show that if $C_r^*(\mathbb{G})$ is approximately amenable, then $\mathbb{G}$ admits an invariant quantum mean.
